exposure: mother's knowledge about the importance of colostrum
cohort: 201 mothers (102 urban, 99 rural) in the Deyang region of China.
finding: The prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding at one week postpartum was very low (8.0%), with higher rates of almost exclusive breastfeeding (34.5%) and mixed feeding (56.0%).
mod_finding: Cesarean section prevalence was high in both urban and rural areas (63.9 % urban vs. 68.4 % rural).
